name: Day Yeast
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: couple of quarts of cold water
ingredients.originalText: a couple of quarts of cold water

instructions.text: Take 1 dozen large potatoes and boil till well done
Drain the potatoes on the following ingredients: 2 cups flour, 1 teaspoon ginger, 3 1/2 cup salt, 1/8 cup sugar
Drain the water on while hot and if too thick put a couple of quarts of cold water on to thin it down to the consistency of cream
Set away in a cool cellar. This will last a month

source.originalInstructions:
1. Take 1 dozen large potatoes and boil till well done
2. Drain water and mash fine
3. Drain the potatoes on the following ingredients: 2 cups flour, 1 teaspoon ginger, 3 1/2 cup salt, 1/8 cup sugar
4. Drain the water on while hot and if too thick put a couple of quarts of cold water on to thin it down to the consistency of cream
5. When lukewarm, add 4 yeast cakes
6. Let rise for 24 hours
7. Set away in a cool cellar. This will last a month
